name: Tenshi no Sumu Yakata
source:
Main characters loses parents and in order to calm down goes to a trip abroad alongside two maids. The rest of the staff resign, but why do these two girls stay loyal until the end?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角失去了父母，为了平静下来，和两名女仆一起出国旅行。其余的员工都辞职了，但为什么这两个女孩直到最后仍然忠诚？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
